pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions are irregular, stellate polygons with jagged, serrated edges. The pixel gradients at the boundaries show a transition from dark brown to cream-white hair. These patches occupy a significantly larger spatial area than the inter-patch corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-pigmented negative space forming pathways of variable pixel thickness. The network consists of numerous junction nodes where three or more paths intersect, creating a complex topological grid across the flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The individual hair tufts create a fine-textured fringe against the background foliage.
